# Release Brainstorm

Possible release risks: concurrent worktrees, uncommitted unrelated files, remote divergence, hidden branch-only commits, generated proofs too large for GitHub, deployment secrets unavailable, CI failures, stale deploy workflow, merge conflicts, local-only test artifacts, and a main push that does not actually deploy.

Preferred principle: inspect provenance first; include only release-relevant files; fetch before integration; never force-push; preserve unrelated modifications; run focused and repository-prescribed verification; push one `main`; observe CI/deployment; verify public runtime.
